mechanism.claim: A large Bitcoin fee-curve breadth rotation aligned with block-fullness change marks settlement stress common in volatile markets. If the next 12-hour bucket transports the same direction into witness composition while fee rotation decelerates to at most half, blockspace has absorbed the stress and the direction should relay to BTC for 24 hours after conservative publication delay.
mechanism.side: sign of prior-bucket fee-curve breadth rotation
mechanism.why_distinct: BSAR is an external two-bucket blockspace settlement transition with frozen +48h source latency. It uses no BTC price path, implied-volatility candle, funding direction, OI, or prior candidate control.
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: 12-hour mined-block composition plus 48-hour delayed availability is structurally independent of all Gross9 clocks

clock.buckets: two consecutive exact 12-hour UTC mined-block buckets p then c
clock.features: R=24h fee-curve low-minus-high log-fee rotation; W=24h witness-share change; U=24h fullness change; Q=mean(abs(W),abs(U)); strict-prior midranks use up to 180 valid buckets and require 120
clock.trigger: false-to-true onset on exact consecutive valid buckets
clock.availability: later frozen source availability for c, exactly bucket end +48h
clock.entry: ceil availability to 5m then one full 5m bar later
clock.reservation: global half-open, exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only for later PnL

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding marks, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_price: sealed until source-support and Gross9 novelty pass
